question: What Are GOOSE, MMS and Sampled Values in IEC 61850?
body_html:
IEC 61850 is the international standard for communication in power utility automation, defining how IEDs in substations exchange data with each other and with SCADA over Ethernet. It uses three communication services.

ServiceTransportPurpose
GOOSELayer 2 multicast, under 4 msProtection and control signals between IEDs
MMSTCP/IP client serverNon time critical data between IEDs and SCADA
Sampled ValuesLayer 2 multicast streamTime synchronised current and voltage samples from merging units
